answer_1.quote: We use the ClipCap caption generation system without fine-tuning... We generate a single neural caption for each IMAGECODE target image by passing it through ClipCap.

answer_2.quote: 0-shot image retrieval accuracy improves by almost 6% compared to the highest previously reported human-caption-based performance... Table 1: Percentage IMAGECODE accuracy of 0-shot image retriever when given neural vs. human captions as input.

answer_4.quote: We organized a crowd-sourcing experiment in which human subjects had to perform the same 10-image-set target discrimination task... Participants were asked to click on the image that matched the caption best.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were shown a caption and ten images and asked to select the image that best matches the caption.
